title: I made 20 AI analyst personas debate every US stock instead of giving one AI "pick" (dev here)
author: seviniryusuf
selftext:
I'm the developer, so take this as a builder sharing, not an ad.

Most AI stock tools give you one confident answer. I went the other way: a panel of 20 AI analyst personas (value, growth, momentum, risk and so on) each scores a stock and they often disagree. You see the bull case, the bear case and why, and the blend becomes a 0–100 score split into technical, fundamental and sentiment.

You can test your own read with paper trading ($100k virtual cash, live prices), so it's a sandbox rather than a signal service. No buy/sell calls, no return claims.

Short tour of the live app: https://gettickr.ai/tour?c=reddit_ai_trading

Curious what people here think: does a disagreeing panel actually help you reason about a trade, or is one well-explained model better?

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: 20 personas off the same model share the same training and the same blind spots, so a lot of that disagreement is just wording.
